before.test/counter_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule CounterTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "adds to the public count" do
    {:ok, pid} = Counter.start_link()
    :ok = Counter.add(pid, 2)
    assert Counter.value(pid) == 2
    assert :sys.get_state(pid) == %{value: 2}
  end
end

after.test/counter_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule CounterTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "adds to the public count" do
    {:ok, pid} = Counter.start_link()
    :ok = Counter.add(pid, 2)
    assert Counter.value(pid) == 2
  end
end
